text: I'll start with the workload named in the page.

remediation.name: checkout-worker
remediation.required_value: env entry name: AMQP_URL with the queue connection string as its value (e.g. - name: AMQP_URL\n  value: amqp://<user>:<pass>@<rabbitmq-host>:5672/)

arguments.root_cause_statement: Deployment payments/checkout-worker ships a container whose command hard-requires the AMQP_URL environment variable, but its pod template defines no env at all. Every pod the ReplicaSet creates therefore starts, prints "FATAL: AMQP_URL not set", exits 1, and is restarted by the kubelet into CrashLoopBackOff, so the Deployment never reports a ready replica and checkout jobs are never consumed from the queue. There is nothing in the namespace the variable could have been sourced from either: the only ConfigMap present is kube-root-ca.crt and there are no Secrets, so the fix is to add the AMQP_URL env entry (backed by a real config/secret source) to the Deployment's container spec.
arguments.mechanism: Deployment payments/checkout-worker's container "worker" runs a command that exits 1 unless AMQP_URL is set, yet .spec.template.spec.containers[worker].env is absent entirely (the pod reports "Environment:    <none>"), so the container terminates with Reason: Error, Exit Code: 1 after logging "FATAL: AMQP_URL not set". The kubelet keeps restarting it — "Back-off restarting failed container worker" — leaving the container in waiting=CrashLoopBackOff with restarts=5 and the Deployment at ready=0/1.

evidence.claim: The paged Deployment has no ready replica and its only pod is crash-looping.
The worker container is in CrashLoopBackOff after repeated Error exits.
The container's previous instance died explicitly because AMQP_URL was unset.
The container command requires AMQP_URL and exits 1 when it is empty.
The Deployment pod template defines no environment variables for the worker container.
The container terminates with an error exit and the kubelet keeps restarting it.
evidence.quote: Back-off restarting failed container worker in pod checkout-worker-66bfcdfc47-d9gdj_payments

ruled_out.alternative: The env var was meant to come from a ConfigMap key that is missing or misnamed (configMapKeyRef/envFrom pointing at an app config).
ruled_out.ruling_claim: The pod template contains no envFrom or valueFrom reference at all, and the namespace's only ConfigMap is the cluster CA bundle, so no config source was ever wired in.

ruled_out.alternative: The value was supposed to come from a Secret that is absent or key-mismatched.
ruled_out.ruling_claim: There are no Secrets in the namespace at all, so no secretKeyRef could have resolved or failed.
ruled_out.quote: 0 objects of kind secrets in namespace payments

ruled_out.alternative: Image pull failure or scheduling/capacity pressure keeping the pod from running.
ruled_out.ruling_claim: The image was already present and the container was created and started repeatedly on a Ready node; the failure is at runtime, not at pull or schedule time.
ruled_out.quote: Container image "busybox:1.36" already present on machine and can be accessed by the pod
